why: Relaxing C4 to allow noun+modifier cuts when forbidding them would force very-short pieces caused the scorer to merge some noun+modifier spans but often pushed cut points onto small trailing complements or split predicates/prepositional attachments; that produced a small net drop in H_set, concentrated in the short-to-medium latency bins (≤3–≤10).
lesson: A later revision should respect that easing the noun+modifier ban to avoid tiny (≈≤3–5 word) pieces can reduce extreme fragmentation in some examples but must not systematically shift boundaries onto very-short trailing fragments or break predicates, since that harms short/medium bins overall.
